final:
checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  post out != None or (a >= 0 and b >= 0) or (a < 0 and b < 0)
  ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(-5, 3) == -2
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
  ex checked_add(-9223372036854775807, -2) == None
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, -1) == 9223372036854775806
  let mx = 9223372036854775807
  if a >= 0 and b >= 0
    if a > mx - b
      return None
    return a + b
  if a < 0 and b < 0
    if a + 1 < -mx - b
      return None
    return a + b
  a + b

test_checked_add() =
  assert checked_add(2, 3) == 5
  assert checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
